answer: Resist sybils with marble-sealed identity and a ripple of endorsements. First, each agent registers one hardware-bound marble seal that cannot be cloned, so one device equals one identity. Second, newcomers must collect endorsements rippling outward from three agents who stake tokens on their behaviour. Third, a nadir floor blocks cheaters: any agent caught cheating falls to zero trust and loses its stake. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 devices and 30,000 endorsers risking funds. A sybil swarm is like counterfeit coins in a marble vault: shiny at a glance, worthless under inspection.
